title: Targeting Misalignment: A Conflict-Aware Framework for Reward-Model-based LLM Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a biased proxy reward model by restricting its training data to a limited subset of categories (e.g., only 8 out of 19 safety harm categories or a limited split of helpfulness data) to evaluate how incomplete supervision causes misalignment, measured via Proxy-Policy Alignment Conflict Score (PACS) and Kendall-Tau Distance.
